description: This file defines a Java interface 'SortFieldExpressionVisitor' used for visiting different kinds of sort field expressions within a query expression processing context.

classes.name: SortFieldExpressionVisitor
classes.description: A generic interface representing a visitor pattern for different types of sort field expressions in query models, allowing implementations to define specific behavior for each type.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Method to process an attribute-based sort field identified by a key string.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Method to process a feature ID property with specified featureId and property names.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Method to process a simple sort field identified by its field name.
